chain_words.nuance: quick to learn and to understand practical situations
good at solving problems with ingenuity
a general capacity to reason, learn and understand
able to judge situations accurately and to notice what others miss
exceptionally insightful in understanding people, texts or hidden meanings

explanation: These words all describe mental ability, moving from quick practical understanding to a deep insight into subtle meanings.

usage_notes.difference: 'Clever' suggests ingenuity in solving problems; 'astute' suggests sharp judgement about people or situations.
